# Migrating to App Stylr v1.0.0

Version 1.0.0 establishes the reusable public package interface. It removes private family and consumer governance from the package and repository, adds explicit public exports, and makes npm, GitHub tags, and Swift Package Manager independently verifiable installation channels.

## Required changes

1. Replace imports from `app-stylr/family` with an application-owned or private-governance data source.
2. Remove calls to the former sibling-repository fleet audit; rollout governance belongs outside the public package.
3. Update the dependency and optional `app-stylr.json` manifest to `1.0.0`.
4. Import `app-stylr/fonts.css` and `app-stylr/css`, or use the `AppStylr` Swift module.
5. Replace raw application-chrome colors with semantic roles.
6. Refresh copied public templates deliberately.
7. Run the application’s tests and inspect affected states in both themes.

The visual token values from 0.5.0 remain compatible. The breaking change is the removal of private governance exports and repository-specific operating assumptions.

See the [complete raw-color migration example](../../examples/migration/README.md).
